correctness.rationale: The split channel has matching cutset and block-Markov rate D+min(C1,C2). Shiu's common CF relaxation, conditioned post-processing SDPI, and I(Xr;Z|B)<=C2 give a uniform D+eta C2 bound, while DF is at most C1. The BSC region follows by eta=(1-2p)^2 and monotonicity of BSC capacity.

originality.rationale: The inspected Shiu preprint gives only the fixed p=q=1/4 BSC counterexample. Targeted searches found no arbitrary-component-channel contraction template or full 0<p<=q<1/2 BSC counterexample family. The result has material folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk because it is a concise abstraction of a very recent proof.

value.rationale: The theorem exposes a structural SDPI mechanism behind the failure, produces a broad counterexample class rather than a single point, and gives an explicit p=q=1/8 witness with a certified gap about 0.19969 bits/use.
